text: 2026-08-03 implementation: added first-class RankDiagnostics to pivoted OLS. Reports now retain factorization method, numerical rank, tolerance, complete pivot order, independent/aliased predictor indices, QR diagonal magnitudes, and a condition estimate. Rank-deficient QR preparation returns typed FitError.RankDeficientDesign(report) instead of only SingularDesign. Dense and runwise fit results resolve reports against CoefficientAxis as StructuralRankReport with stable structural columns and design fingerprint. OlsSuite and S16 now assert numeric partitioning and structural alias resolution; focused OLS/S16 passes 18/18 on JVM and JS. Broader engine and alias-calibration gates remain open.
